brief:
Jerusalem District Electricity Company announced it will cut power from 8:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, the Ma'an news agency reported. The outage will affect several areas in Ramallah and Al-Bireh governorate, according to the utility's statement.

The company did not specify the reason for the scheduled blackout or provide details on which neighborhoods would be affected beyond noting parts of the Ramallah and Al-Bireh area.

title: Jerusalem electricity company cuts power across Ramallah districts
